title: A-button interaction hands one live wild actor to battle

verification.actor: WILD species 19 (rattata), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Spawn one Wild Rattata through the checked encounter command; approach that same current actor with normal directional input while its first natural Walk settles; then press A after the Walk completes
verification.observable: The native battle request succeeds once and names the same live slot, species, personality and encounter generation as the bound Wild Rattata; the request follows one complete natural Walk and a natural A edge

setupMutations.change: Use checked teleport and spawn commands with test.sav, then bind the exact finalized Wild Rattata identity before natural motion and player input.

limits: Prepared teleport and spawn setup give no motion, input or battle handoff credit.
The case proves one Rattata capture request on Route 29; it does not prove every Wild species or battle result.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Prepare Route 29, spawn one finalized Wild Rattata, and bind its current identity
During the first natural Rattata Walk, use normal directional input to stand next to it, then wait for that Walk to finish
Press A and require one successful native request for its exact slot, species, personality, and encounter generation

stop.condition: The exact live wild identity reaches the battle script request

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
